description: 3 should-trigger + 3 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers a bug with several plausible causes across layers, competing hypotheses to validate, and a German phrasing. Should-not-trigger covers near-miss neighbours (a broad project overview, implementing an already-proven fix) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: orders are sometimes duplicated, could be the queue, the API or the database, why is this happening?
list competing hypotheses for this cross-layer bug and validate each against evidence
warum passiert das? Der Fehler kann mehrere Ursachen in verschiedenen Schichten haben
give me a broad overview of this project's architecture
queries.note: a broad overview without a specific problem is discovery, not hypothesis testing

queries.q: the cause is proven, the null check is missing, add it
queries.note: a proven cause needs implementation only
